vibe_rationale: Credible indie and alt-pop curation, but a large commercial one-day festival run by a ticketing group with little community programming.
fit_notes: Music-first festival with a 16-plus entry floor, so the crowd skews younger than an adult health audience and lifestyle programming is limited. A sampling, lounge or hospitality activation is the likely format, and a named sponsorship agency contact and dedicated contact page make the route visible.
